knowledge_gaps: The ordered encoder is underspecified: exact tokenizer, vocabulary scope, truncation lengths, convolution channels, activation, padding rules, pooling and treatment of fields shorter than a kernel are missing. Masking every partially padded window can discard short titles entirely.

The pooled-text comparison lacks a defined capacity control. Changes in parameter count, residual scale or computation could explain improvements attributed to token order. Originality 5 and potential 7 are provisional judgments; difficulty 5 lacks runtime and memory evidence.

The evaluation plan omits paired validation uncertainty, repeated-selection limitations and concrete shortcut controls. Perturbation sensitivity alone cannot distinguish useful attribute learning from arbitrary sensitivity. Diagnostic provenance and negative sampling must also be documented before comparing category error rates.

follow_up_queries.reason: Find implementation precedents that resolve short-text masking and make the order hypothesis testable. The final architecture and defaults still require explicit specification.
follow_up_queries.query: For a text CNN trained from scratch on item titles and descriptions inside one HSTU recommender, what convolution padding, valid-window masking, short-sequence handling and pooling practices preserve local word order? Find capacity-controlled comparisons against mean pooling, including width-3/5 kernels and fields shorter than the kernel.

follow_up_queries.reason: Check whether established controls can separate useful attribute distinctions from popularity, brand and text-availability shortcuts, strengthening the novelty and potential assessment.
follow_up_queries.query: What research evaluates shortcut learning in jointly trained item-ID and text sequential recommenders without pretrained encoders? Look for retrained shuffled-text controls, popularity- and text-length-matched comparisons, and word-order or numerical-attribute perturbations that distinguish semantic learning from arbitrary sensitivity.

follow_up_queries.reason: Ground the validation analysis in suitable statistical methods while preserving the pinned evaluator and single-seed constraint.
follow_up_queries.query: For sequential recommendation evaluated with 200 fixed validation users per category, four-category macro HR@10 and 99 sampled negatives per user, how should paired model comparisons and uncertainty be reported? Find methods addressing within-category paired bootstrap, repeated checkpoint or hyperparameter selection, and limitations of sampled ranking metrics relative to full-catalog recommendations.
